title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - AssetsManagement
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/AssetsManagement. Legal document describing the management of assets related to security. Subclass of LegalDocument per the Gaia-X ontology; inherited properties are documented on the LegalDocument model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'AssetsManagement'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

url.description: Property. A resolvable link to the legal document.

mimeTypes.description: Property. The MIME types associated with the legal document.

governingLawCountries.description: Property. Countries under whose laws the document is governed (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes).

involvedParties.description: Relationship. Legal entities involved or mentioned in the legal document. Links to one or more LegalPerson entities.
